name: Deep Forehand
notes: Ball bounces deeper: start 1 step behind baseline

name: Body Ball
notes: Ball comes at you: step away, pick forehand or backhand

name: Push Deep Forehand
notes: Swing low to high, aim high over the net

name: Wide Forehand
notes: Recover to center mark after every shot

name: In and Out Forehand
notes: Run in for the short ball, back for the deep one

name: Topspin Forehand
notes: Ball kicks up: move back, hit it at waist height

name: Slice Forehand
notes: Ball stays low: bend your knees

name: Heavy Forehand
notes: High bouncer: step back or take it early

name: Down-the-Line Forehand
notes: Hit later, point the racket straight

name: Switch It
notes: Odd balls crosscourt (C), even balls down the line (D)

name: BOSS: Sniper
notes: 20 balls. Odd balls crosscourt box (E), even balls down the line (D)

name: Forehand Volley
notes: Stand 2 m from the net. Catch the ball in the air

name: Forehand Approach
notes: Start at baseline, run in, hit, keep going to the net

name: Approach + Volley
notes: Ball 1: forehand approach from baseline. Ball 2: backhand volley

name: Approach + Volley 2
notes: Ball 1: backhand approach. Ball 2: forehand volley

name: Low Volleys
notes: Bend your knees, don't swing, punch

name: BOSS: Net Ninja
notes: 20 balls. Approach, then 2 volleys. Start each pattern at baseline

name: First Overhead
notes: Lob riser on. Stand at service line. Point at the ball with your free hand

name: Backward Overhead
notes: Start at the net, turn and run back

name: Moonball Forehand
notes: Lob riser on. Baseline. Hit the high ball back deep

name: Volley + Overhead
notes: Volley, then step back for the overhead

name: Four-Way Guess
notes: Randomize ON. Recover to center mark

name: Spin Guess
shots: RANDOM: M-F (Top 1), M-F (Top 3), M-F (Slice 1), M-B (Top 1), M-B (Top 3), M-B (Slice 1)

name: Six-Way Guess
shots: RANDOM: M-FW, M-F, M-C, M-B, M-BW, D-C

name: BOSS: Chaos Master
shots: RANDOM: M-FW, M-F, M-B, M-BW, D-F, D-B

name: Point Builder
notes: Rally ball (B), attack the short ball (B), finish with a volley (A)

name: Defend!
notes: Recover to center mark. Hit high and deep to get back in the point

name: Attack!
notes: Randomize ON. Short ball: hit into either corner box

name: Match Chaos
shots: RANDOM: M-FW, M-F, M-C, M-B, M-BW, D-C

name: FINAL BOSS: Champion
shots: RANDOM: M-FW, M-F, M-C, M-B, M-BW, D-F, D-C, D-B, S-C
